# MJ evolution sidecar — pinned dependencies (production infrastructure).
# Install in a dedicated venv. Requires an LLM provider key at runtime.
dspy==2.5.43
# GEPA ships as the standalone `gepa` package. The previously pinned
# `dspy-gepa==0.1.4` was never published to PyPI (404), so this file was
# uninstallable. Note: gepa 0.1.x removed the legacy `GEPA(...).compile(...)`
# class API; mj_evolution/evolve.py targets `gepa.optimize(...)`.
gepa==0.1.4
pydantic==2.9.2
httpx==0.27.2
# fastapi + uvicorn are only used by the OPTIONAL HTTP server
# (mj_evolution/server.py); MJ's canonical transport is stdio. Both are held to
# litellm's ranges because dspy==2.5.43 pins litellm[proxy]==1.53.7, whose proxy
# extra requires fastapi>=0.111.0,<0.112.0 and uvicorn>=0.22.0,<0.23.0. Pinning
# newer versions makes this file unresolvable (pip ResolutionImpossible).
fastapi>=0.111.0,<0.112.0
uvicorn>=0.22.0,<0.23.0
